title: Sertraline-Induced Mood and Behavioral Activation in Two Adults With Prader-Willi Syndrome.
figures: Comparison of the frequency of aberrant behaviors with the change in sertraline dose over time. The disruptive behaviors described in the narrative record of care at the group home have been itemized and tallied to establish a frequency for each week across 1 year's time (no data for December).
